about: Settings for the Daily Video (scripts/daily_video.py, scripts/video_post.py, scripts/buffer_post.py). Turn a platform off by setting it to false; the video is still made every morning. Facebook and Instagram post through Meta's Graph API (META_TOKEN secret); TikTok and X post through Buffer (BUFFER_API_KEY secret) to the accounts named under buffer.accounts. YouTube comes from tools/video/youtube-upload.gs. graphVersion is Meta's Graph API version; voiceSpeed is the radio voice's speed (1.0 is normal).
